title: MyeongsimCoachingCardDataset
description: Schema for Myeongsim Coaching Daily Insight Cards (scalable up to 300+ cards)

category.description: Core mental domain (e.g. 불확실성, 경계와 관계, 완벽주의와 통제, 에너지와 번아웃, 생각 과열, 감정 민감성, 정체성과 관찰, 변화와 시도)

keyword.description: Sub-theme keyword (e.g. 과잉확인, 좋은 사람 강박, 눈치, 반추)

cardTitle.description: Descriptive mode name (e.g. 확인 모드, 착한 아이 모드, 안테나 과출력 모드)

question.description: Relatable user dilemma in quotes (e.g. “왜 나는 확인하고 또 확인할까?”)

sodaAnswer.description: Crisp, punchy 1-line paradigm shift (e.g. 확인은 정보를 얻지만, 반복확인은 불안을 달랩니다.)

curiosityQuestion.description: Resonating 'What about in my case?' bridge question

bookChapter.description: Specific chapter title or principle topic

appCTA.description: Experience-first self-application action verb for the App (e.g. 내 확인 패턴 직접 확인하기)

appSubtext.description: Contextual guide for 1-minute real-life observation in the App

bookCTA.description: Experience-first deep-reading verb for Cheongnyu Books (e.g. 확인 모드의 뇌과학 원리 읽기)

bookSubtext.description: Contextual guide for understanding root principles in the Book

searchKeywords.description: Natural language search phrases & conversational keywords

isPopular.description: Optional flag to highlight in popular questions carousel
